answer: The lantern report makes public the merge explicitly at each pigment. Each collapsed cluster gets one sparrow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an farming party who spins up 83 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 298 times the capital for one share. The per-identity price is 106 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
